name: THE UNDERTAKER
note: THE UNDERTAKER AT GRIEVANCE'S HEAD (doc 110 section 2: "at Grievance's head in his good apron ... He has a hand on her bridle"), while the procession is stalled at Boot Hill's gate (errata 233). Room 31's own figure (funeral_undertaker's sheet), drawn by its figureHeight at Room 14's curve. Examined and talked to through THE UNDERTAKER over him; his words are Room 14's (docBlocks).
